_comment: Department library for general-store ads. 'scene' is injected into the video prompt, so it must describe visuals only -- never signage, labels or price tags, since on-screen text is composited afterwards. 'display' is the uppercase on-screen form; 'vo_noun' is what the voiceover says after 'off on'. Entries generated by the LLM are cached here with source='llm'.

vegetables.scene: the fresh produce section of a bright general store, wooden crates and tiered racks piled high with red tomatoes, green chillies, onions, carrots and leafy coriander, glistening with water droplets under clean daylight

fruits.scene: the fruit aisle of a bright general store, sloped wicker displays of apples, bananas, oranges and ripe mangoes stacked in neat pyramids, warm golden light catching the glossy skins

dairy.scene: the refrigerated dairy aisle of a general store, tall glass-door coolers stacked with milk cartons, curd tubs, butter and cheese blocks, cool blue-white light spilling onto a clean tiled floor

groceries.scene: the dry staples aisle of a general store, deep shelves lined with sacks of rice, transparent bins of lentils and pulses, stacked flour packets and rows of spice jars in warm amber light

snacks.scene: the snack aisle of a general store, tall racks of colourful crinkled chip packets and biscuit stacks receding down a bright aisle, cheerful saturated packaging filling the frame

beverages.scene: the beverage aisle of a general store, glass-front coolers filled with chilled bottles and cans in rows, condensation on the glass, crisp cool lighting reflecting off the surfaces

bakery.scene: the in-store bakery counter of a general store, wooden trays of fresh bread loaves, buns and pastries behind a curved glass case, warm inviting light and a soft haze of flour in the air

frozen.scene: the frozen foods section of a general store, open chest freezers with frost-rimmed edges holding stacked packets and tubs, cold pale light rising from inside the cabinets

household.scene: the household cleaning aisle of a general store, orderly shelves of detergent boxes, bottled floor cleaners and stacked utility supplies, bright even lighting on a spotless polished floor

personal_care.scene: the personal care aisle of a general store, tidy shelves of shampoo bottles, soap cartons and skincare tubes arranged in colour-graded rows, soft flattering light and a clean modern finish

baby_care.scene: the baby care aisle of a general store, soft pastel shelving stacked with diaper packs, baby lotion bottles and feeding bottles, gentle warm lighting and a calm uncluttered layout

toys.scene: the toy aisle of a general store, colourful shelves filled with plush toys, boxed dolls, toy cars and building block sets, bright cheerful lighting and a playful vivid palette

stationery.scene: the stationery aisle of a general store, neat racks of notebooks, pen stands, colour pencil boxes and art supplies arranged in tidy vertical rows under clean bright light

kitchenware.scene: the kitchenware aisle of a general store, gleaming stainless steel pots, pans and storage containers stacked on sturdy shelves, crisp highlights glinting off polished metal

apparel.scene: the apparel section of a general store, garments on tidy hanging rails and folded stacks on wooden tables, soft directional lighting and a warm boutique-like finish

footwear.scene: the footwear section of a general store, angled display shelves of shoes, sandals and sneakers arranged in even rows, clean focused lighting on each pair

electronics.scene: the electronics corner of a general store, glass display cabinets of small appliances and accessories on clean dark shelving, cool crisp lighting with subtle reflections

pet_care.scene: the pet care aisle of a general store, shelves stacked with pet food bags and treat boxes beside hanging leashes and toys, warm friendly lighting

general.scene: a wide bright aisle of a busy modern general store, well-stocked shelves receding on both sides filled with colourful packaged goods, clean floors and inviting even lighting
